name: Loose Threads
source:
The last time you were home, it was your mother's funeral. Now you are back in town and housesitting for your sister.

You are afraid you might run into your old childhood friend again.  The last encounter with them left much unsaid.

Will things change and you both finally have closure? Or will it stay the same. 

[From [url=https://vetharibree.itch.io/loose-threads]itch.io[/url]]
